name: Couch for Trakt
author: Simon Schubert
description: A movie and TV tracker for Trakt: trending, popular, anticipated and streaming titles, the box office, pages with cast, seasons and episodes, and search. Sign in with a code for your up next, calendar, watchlist, history and ratings, and mark episodes and movies watched. Uses the Trakt API over HTTPS; not affiliated with Trakt. Desktop and phone layouts.
